card.name: Literary prose and poetry word endings
card.fires_on: Scattered words in literary, poetic or essayistic prose, often a word that completes or modifies a phrase (e.g. 'Human' in a book title, 'eded' in 'unheeded', 'altogether', 'just'). Mostly archaic or lyrical passages about poets, nature and art.

card.writes: It suppresses words like subtle, nuanced, intricate and meticulously, so it steers away from those descriptive adjectives.
card.plain: It lights up on odd words in flowery, poetic writing and holds back words like 'subtle' or 'intricate'.
